title: Fugal has seen UFOs in the air himself

tellings.quote: I've seen them myself in the air. I mean, right.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, says he has personally seen unidentified flying objects in the sky. He says it in passing, as a first-hand matter, "I've seen them myself in the air," without giving a time or place. It makes him a witness, not just the owner of a place where others report such things.
